brief.persona: I am booking a service visit for a home water softener.
brief.objective: Book a pest control visit to handle an ant issue at my residence.
facts: I have discovered carpenter ants in my kitchen and basement.
My property is a single-family house at 742 Evergreen Terrace.
preferences: I prefer pet-safe treatment options if available.
I prefer email confirmation sent after booking.

adjacent: You may also arrange service for the drinking-water filtration unit on the same visit if they raise it.

authorizedCommitments: Book one service visit on any weekday within the next three weeks.

spend.basis: for this visit including the call-out fee and any parts fitted

menuHints: The main menu offers service on 1, billing on 2.

fields.name: agreedAmount
fields.description: Total amount agreed in USD, or empty if nothing was agreed

fields.name: appointmentStart
fields.description: Start of the booked arrival window, e.g. 2026-08-25T08:00

fields.name: appointmentEnd
fields.description: End of the booked arrival window, e.g. 2026-08-25T12:00

fields.name: secondUnitIncluded
fields.description: yes or no — whether the drinking-water unit is included in the visit

script.label: ivr_greeting
script.text: Thank you for calling Apex Pest Defense. For service scheduling, press 1. For billing inquiries, press 2.

script.label: agent_intro
script.text: Thank you for holding. This is Alex in service scheduling. How can I help you today?

script.label: ask_address
script.text: I can definitely help get that set up. May I have your name and the service address, please?

script.label: ask_pest_details
script.text: Thank you. Could you briefly describe the pest issue you are experiencing?

script.label: quote_price
script.text: For a complete interior and exterior treatment for carpenter ants, our fee is exactly 430 dollars.

script.label: offer_time_window
script.text: Our next available opening is this Thursday between 8:00 AM and 12:00 PM. Would that window work for you?

script.label: ask_contact_number
script.text: Wonderful. What is the best phone number for our technician to reach you on arrival day?

script.label: confirm_details
script.text: I have you down for Thursday between 8:00 AM and 12:00 PM at 742 Evergreen Terrace for 430 dollars. Shall I finalize this booking?

script.label: agent_wrapup
script.text: You are all scheduled. Our technician will see you Thursday morning. Thank you for choosing Apex Pest Defense, and have a great day!

script.label: Closing Confirmation
script.text: No, that's everything I need from you — you're all set. Thanks for calling, goodbye.
